title: Lucid moment followed by an "angry mob"
content: OK so I'm kindof excited because I was able to sustain some lucidity in a dream longer than usual. Nothing major, just was able to keep focus long enough to float forward faster in a dream scene for a longer time. What is odd is that once I did that for a time, it felt like a bunch of random dream people popped up out of nowhere, suddenly eyeing me and tried to like straight up moshpit me out of the dream. Like I got the whole "your not supposed to be here" or "hey you can't do that here" type of looks. Then I sort of retained lucidity for a hot second, but had no control over the dream location, like it became so much more chaotic. I'm curious; was it just my subconscious being defensive, did I accidentally intrude on someone else's dreamscape, or did I encounter some parasitic entities like people in the New Age/5D vibes community have mentioned? Thoughts? Comments? Critiques? Dad jokes?
